criteria.passage: I’d apologise, say I’ve taken over, and explain I’m reviewing the case and checking the next steps with the relevant team.
criteria.rationale: This clearly explains what the candidate would do and how they would communicate the situation to the customer in understandable terms.

criteria.passage: I’d apologise, say I’ve taken over, and explain I’m reviewing the case and checking the next steps with the relevant team. I’d give them my contact details and follow up once I have more information.
criteria.rationale: The candidate sets a limited, justified expectation by saying they are reviewing the case and will follow up once more information is available, without making unsupported promises about resolution timing or outcome.

criteria.passage: I’d give them my contact details and follow up once I have more information.
criteria.rationale: This provides a concrete follow-up mechanism: giving contact details and committing to follow up when information is available.
